goal: Prevent a SummonScout client from creating summon-pending state for unrelated party/raid joins; only joins backed by this client's destination-qualified tracked invite may enter the automatic summon queue, while explicit grouped resume requests remain supported.
notes: ASAP Lua-only guard for the observed Hyjal-only client logging 'party join -> summon pending' for Deitara after a World request for Silithus. Root cause: syncPartyRoster still calls queuePartySummon for every newly observed group member, despite the existing pendingManualInvites ownership marker added for SummonScout's own eligible invites. The hot guard replaces the roster-facing queue upvalue with an ownership check: tracked SummonScout invites pass through to the original queue; unrelated group joins are ignored before summon-pending is created. The exported queue API is left unchanged so grouped 123/ready/combat-resume flows still work.
